label: Every actual root withholds each grounded being, from willed giving, WN and SS
description: Argument N3, the will route (the structure of ST I q.19 a.3 co., navigation only, not attributed): a second, partly independent support bundle for (a), from the will and perfection families instead of the modal profile of the root's giving. Not a transcription. Establishes no premise. Simplicity enters through one power: it makes every giving of the root an exercise of its one rational power (uniform kind of power), not a uniform mode; WN and SS supply the mode. With reflexive access (b) is idle here (controls, law 5). Shared dependencies: 0c27f65a and 5c1aba17 (hence will following intellect, 090be689) are also inputs of #1944's arguments 2 and 5, so N3 adds nothing against a rival that denies intellect at the root; its value is against the Avicennian rival, which grants an intellectual, self-sufficient First and must now deny WN. Omission models: without WN and without SS (the mixed-mode root), without 5c1aba17 (natural emanation by an intellectual root), without one power, without 0c27f65a (an emanating root without intellect), without (b) (a non-reflexive frame).
